context_requirements: Monocyte/macrophage or other CCR2-expressing accessory cells in the culture (CCR2 is largely absent from these epithelial lines)
Basal or ligand-driven CCR2/CCR5 signaling; autocrine CCL2/CCL5 production
Intact NF-kB/AP-1 signaling for secondary inflammatory gene induction
falsifiers: No change in any of CCL2, CXCL2, IL1B, PTGS2, MMP1, ICAM1 at 24 h in any line
Strong, reproducible 6 h transcriptional signature in all nine lines
Dose-dependent, class-wide changes in proliferation or apoptosis markers at 24 h

evidence.supports: CCR5 antagonism by maraviroc reduces chemokine-driven gastric cancer cell migration and adhesion, indicating CCR antagonists can modulate tumor-cell transcriptional programs only where the receptor is expressed
